title: An fppf covering has an integral surjection with open local lifts
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in the universes [def-weil-size-convention], and let $\{f_i:X_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ be a small fppf covering [def-pc-fppf-site]: every $f_i$ is flat and locally of finite presentation and the family is jointly surjective. There exist an integral morphism $q:Y\to X$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] which is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], a small open covering $Y=\bigcup_{\alpha\in A}W_\alpha$ [def-weil-open-immersion], indices $i(\alpha)\in I$, and $X$-morphisms $h_\alpha:W_\alpha\to X_{i(\alpha)}$, so $f_{i(\alpha)}\circ h_\alpha=q|_{W_\alpha}$. There is no quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness assumption on $X$, and no finiteness or finite-presentation assertion about $q$. The empty scheme and the empty covering are allowed.
